meta.title: Carthage Underfoot
meta.status: Checkpoint 1 — archive credits and descriptions are being verified
meta.honestyNote: Scanned artifacts are real documentation. The low-poly terrain, walls, columns, vegetation, placeholders, and artifact placements are modern abstractions, not archaeological reconstructions.

zones.name: Byrsa Plateau
zones.blurb: This group follows the Byrsa Hill find-site labels in the Tanit XR archive. The plateau around the objects is a navigational abstraction, not a reconstruction.

zones.name: Roman Villas Terrace
zones.blurb: This group follows the Roman Villas of Carthage labels in the Tanit XR archive. The terrace is a navigational abstraction, not a reconstruction.

zones.name: Tophet of Salammbô
zones.blurb: This group follows the Tophet of Salammbô find-site labels in the Tanit XR archive. The enclosure and rows are interpretive staging, not a reconstruction.

zones.name: Baths Edge / Architecture
zones.blurb: This temporary zone holds the archive's architectural fragments while their exact documented find-site is checked. Its seaward setting and placement are interpretive.

zones.name: Tunisia Details Court
zones.blurb: This separate study court presents downloaded Tanit XR scans from other Tunisian heritage sites. Their labels name their actual source places; they are not presented as finds from Carthage.
